intro: Explore Lanzarote’s volcanic landscapes, beaches, whitewashed villages and coastal resorts. Plan days out and keep your holiday photos, favourite places and memorable visits privately on your device.

areas.name: Puerto del Carmen
areas.description: Popular south-east resort with several beaches, seafront restaurants and a long promenade.

areas.name: Playa Blanca
areas.description: Southern resort with a marina, beaches, waterfront dining and ferries to Fuerteventura.

areas.name: Costa Teguise
areas.description: East-coast resort with beaches, shops, watersports and family facilities.

areas.name: Arrecife
areas.description: Island capital with a harbour, local shops and the Charco de San Ginés lagoon.

areas.name: Teguise
areas.description: Historic inland town known for traditional architecture and its Sunday market.

areas.name: Haría
areas.description: Green northern valley and village with palms and scenic drives.

areas.name: Yaiza
areas.description: Whitewashed village near the volcanic landscapes of the south-west.

areas.name: Órzola
areas.description: Northern fishing village and ferry departure point for La Graciosa.

attractions.name: Timanfaya National Park
attractions.description: Spectacular volcanic scenery and guided visitor experiences. Access and tour arrangements may change; check official information.

attractions.name: Jameos del Agua
attractions.description: Art, architecture and a volcanic cave setting created by César Manrique; check ticket availability.

attractions.name: Cueva de los Verdes
attractions.description: Guided visit through a volcanic lava tube; book ahead where required.

attractions.name: Mirador del Río
attractions.description: Northern viewpoint with views over La Graciosa, designed by César Manrique.

attractions.name: Jardín de Cactus
attractions.description: Cactus garden in a former quarry near Guatiza.

attractions.name: Fundación César Manrique
attractions.description: Art and architecture in the artist’s former home near Tahíche.

attractions.name: Castillo de San José
attractions.description: Historic fortress in Arrecife housing an international contemporary art museum.

attractions.name: Los Hervideros
attractions.description: Coastal volcanic rock formations; observe the sea from designated safe paths.

beaches.name: Playa Grande, Puerto del Carmen
beaches.description: Long sandy beach near the main resort promenade; check beach flags.

beaches.name: Playa de los Pocillos
beaches.description: Broad sandy beach in Puerto del Carmen, often exposed to wind.

beaches.name: Playa Blanca
beaches.description: Central resort beach with nearby cafés and amenities.

beaches.name: Playa Dorada
beaches.description: Sheltered-looking bay near Playa Blanca; conditions can still change.

beaches.name: Playa de Papagayo
beaches.description: Scenic coves in the south; access roads and facilities may be limited.

beaches.name: Playa de las Cucharas
beaches.description: Costa Teguise beach popular for watersports; check wind and sea conditions.

beaches.name: Playa de Famara
beaches.description: Long, dramatic beach with strong surf and currents; take particular care and follow safety advice.

beaches.name: Playa del Reducto
beaches.description: City beach in Arrecife with a promenade and nearby services.

markets.name: Teguise Sunday market
markets.description: Well-known market in the historic town; check current day, hours and transport.

markets.name: Marina Rubicón market
markets.description: Market stalls around the Playa Blanca marina on scheduled days; check locally.

markets.name: Haría craft market
markets.description: Smaller market featuring local crafts; check operating days.

markets.name: Arrecife shopping streets
markets.description: Local shops and cafés around the capital’s centre and waterfront.

markets.name: Biosfera Plaza, Puerto del Carmen
markets.description: Shopping centre with stores and dining; check opening hours.

nightlife.name: Puerto del Carmen seafront
nightlife.description: Restaurants, music venues and bars around the resort; check opening times.

nightlife.name: Playa Blanca marina evenings
nightlife.description: Waterfront restaurants and relaxed evening walks around Marina Rubicón.

nightlife.name: Costa Teguise centre
nightlife.description: Bars and restaurants around the main resort streets and squares.

nightlife.name: Arrecife waterfront
nightlife.description: Evening cafés and restaurants near Charco de San Ginés.

nightlife.name: Sunset coastal strolls
nightlife.description: Enjoy resort promenades after dark; use well-lit routes and follow local advice.

family.name: Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park
family.description: Animal encounters and family entertainment near Puerto del Carmen; check schedules and suitability.

family.name: Aqualava Waterpark
family.description: Waterpark in Playa Blanca; check opening times and height restrictions.

family.name: Aquapark Costa Teguise
family.description: Waterpark with slides and family activities; check seasonal opening.

family.name: Jameos del Agua
family.description: Distinctive volcanic setting that may appeal to older children; check accessibility.

family.name: Submarine Safari, Puerto Calero
family.description: Underwater sightseeing excursion; check availability, age restrictions and sea conditions.

family.name: Family beach day
family.description: Choose a supervised beach where possible and follow local swimming flags.

dining.name: Puerto del Carmen promenade
dining.description: Wide choice of cafés, tapas and international restaurants.

dining.name: Playa Blanca waterfront
dining.description: Restaurants and cafés near the harbour and marina.

dining.name: Costa Teguise centre
dining.description: Family dining and cafés around the resort squares.

dining.name: Arrecife – Charco de San Ginés
dining.description: Lagoon-side restaurants and local food options.

dining.name: Teguise old town
dining.description: Small cafés and restaurants in a historic setting.

dining.name: Canarian specialities
dining.description: Look for papas arrugadas with mojo, grilled fish and local cheeses; check dietary needs.

daytrips.name: Timanfaya volcanic landscapes
daytrips.description: A memorable excursion through volcanic scenery; check park access and tour arrangements.

daytrips.name: North Lanzarote loop
daytrips.description: Combine Jameos del Agua, Cueva de los Verdes and Mirador del Río; allow time for ticketed visits.

daytrips.name: La Graciosa island
daytrips.description: Take a ferry from Órzola; check sailing schedules and weather before travelling.

daytrips.name: Teguise and Haría
daytrips.description: Visit traditional towns, markets and inland scenery.

daytrips.name: El Golfo and Los Hervideros
daytrips.description: Explore the green lagoon viewpoint and dramatic coastline; remain on marked paths.

daytrips.name: Fuerteventura by ferry
daytrips.description: Day trip from Playa Blanca to Corralejo; check ferry times and ID requirements.

daytrips.name: La Geria wine region
daytrips.description: Discover distinctive volcanic vineyards; arrange safe transport if tasting wine.

transport.name: Intercity buses
transport.description: Public buses connect major towns and resorts; check IntercityBus Lanzarote for current routes and fares.

transport.name: Lanzarote Airport (ACE)
transport.description: Airport near Arrecife; confirm transfers and taxi fares before travel.

transport.name: Taxis
transport.description: Use licensed taxis and confirm fares or meters as appropriate.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Useful for remote viewpoints; check insurance, road conditions and parking rules.

transport.name: Órzola–La Graciosa ferry
transport.description: Passenger ferries connect the north of Lanzarote with La Graciosa; services depend on weather.

transport.name: Playa Blanca–Corralejo ferry
transport.description: Ferries connect Lanzarote and Fuerteventura; confirm times and vehicle arrangements.

transport.name: Walking and cycling
transport.description: Carry water and sun protection; exposed volcanic terrain can be hot and windy.

useful.name: Emergency services
useful.description: Call 112 for emergencies in Spain and the Canary Islands.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€). Check card fees and exchange rates with your provider.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Lanzarote follows Canary Islands time, normally the same as the UK.

useful.name: Sun and wind
useful.description: Use sun protection, carry water and check local wind and sea conditions.

useful.name: Healthcare and insurance
useful.description: Check travel insurance and UK GHIC/EHIC guidance before travelling.

useful.name: Accessibility
useful.description: Check steps, uneven volcanic surfaces and venue accessibility before visiting.

useful.name: Live details
useful.description: Opening times, ticket prices, bus routes and ferry schedules can change; check official sources.
